title: A page option that hands an act to the owner must say whether a session can do it and with which tool, or the question guard refuses it
why: Runner 11's ask (13:23 CST Nov 17), relayed by the coordinator 13:22 CST. Incident: page item 929 option d said the owner merges the five setup PRs by hand. Runner 11 waited about 21 hours for an act the owner told it at 13:20 CST it could do itself with the GitHub MCP plain merge. A goal's done test hung on the wrongly assigned act and the Stop hook looped about 70 turns. The coordinator carried option d as recommended, so the mistake was its too. Rule: output-never-hand-off-doable-step.
source: Coordinator message 13:22 CST Nov 17; runner 11's word, not read by triage.
note: Todo. Guard: an option that hands an act to the owner must say whether a session can do it and with which tool; hooks/question_form.py refuses the write otherwise.
